read.en: MP Materials fell 0.7% on Oct 23 to $38.30, trading between $37.11 and $38.87 on light volume (0.61 times average). It is below all its falling averages: 5-day ($38.87), 10-day ($40.19), 30-day ($45.39), 100-day ($50.84) and 200-day ($55.81). MACD has been below its signal since Aug 31 and below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($43.43), and RSI is 30.
read.zh: MP Materials 10月23日下跌 0.7%，收于 $38.30，盘中区间 $37.11–38.87，成交清淡（为平均水平的 0.61 倍）。股价位于所有下行均线下方：5 日（$38.87）、10 日（$40.19）、30 日（$45.39）、100 日（$50.84）和 200 日均线（$55.81）。MACD 自 8月31日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$43.43），RSI 为 30。

read.en: A new 52-week low at $37.11 undercut the $37.57–37.81 lows, but the close again held above them. Resistance is $38.6–38.9 (Oct 15 low, 5-day, Oct 23 high), then $40–40.2 (10-day) and $43.4–44.5 (SAR, Oct 1 low). Support is $37.1–37.8, then $35. A close above $40.2 would target $43.4; a close below $37.1 would open $35.
